svg.title: The lifted recursion uses hZ j = jjhj(p ·) and the same inclusions, so induction gives peZ v = ev and eZ v = jev for section inputs. Multilinearity recovers every finite channel term. If ρj(R) is the actual orthogonal action on Hj, use ρZ j (R) = jjρj(R)pj on its horizontal image. The same induction intertwines these actions, translations and conjugation. At the root retain only hm to recover the specified degree-m output. This transports the full homogeneous vector and its tested discrepancy while allowing basis channels to mix under ρm(R).
